content:
The transformation script failed to remove layout cache elements due to a case-sensitivity mismatch in the XML tag name.
The test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache failed with an AssertionError because it found an <hp:linesegarray> element remaining in the document. The transform.py script attempted to remove '{...}lineSegArray' (camelCase), but the test expected the lowercase '{...}linesegarray' variant. Trace analysis confirms the script's removal logic missed the specific tag present in the HWPX schema version used by the validator.
